title: how to generate quality sprites for 2d - rpg using codex? or whats the alternative

replies.author: Lucky-Finish7331
replies.body: How did you make the sheet? which model? claude cant generate images

replies.author: goblingamescompany
replies.body:
I tried a lot of things. In the end, I almade sure I had an art direction markdown file with tone, colors, etc. Claude helped me create it. I'll have some games that I like plus the style (pixel).

It then called replicate choosing the right model itself and would give me a cut of four to choose from. From there if refine until happy and then ask it to generate 4 directions, just walking.

Weapons or add ones could be separate and then applied with relative positions in unity in the game objects ( Claude can do this). Trying to generate the sprites with anything other than clothes and body rarely works. Faces were complicated too.
